opening.argument: The video promotes a bot with a daily profit claim and a reported profit of approximately 0.3 Ethereum. It gives viewers a concrete funding-and-deployment sequence: connect a wallet, deploy the contract, send 1 Ether, and press the action button to start automated buying and selling. The description then ties a claimed 175~180% better return to a 1.5 ETH deposit. Together, these are not merely general trading commentary; they present a contract-based bot, require viewers to fund it, and attach specific profit expectations to that funding.
